offending_extra_words: and all amounts due from Corio under this Agreement
reasons: All preferred atomic elements are satisfied: greater-of cap with the exact fee basis and claim anchor plus the USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual application, untouched mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and the full uncapped carve-out set including fraud and IP infringement.

Minimality fails on the payment-obligations sentence: the preferred position asks only that Customer's payment obligations be excluded from "damages", but the insertion also adds "and all amounts due from Corio under this Agreement" — Corio is the paying/customer party in this agreement, so the addition is duplicative extra protection beyond what the level requires.

Minimality also fails on residual drafting debris in the cap: "TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES" survives after the new lowercase fee basis, leaving a dangling qualifier that echoes the deleted per-transaction limitation and could be read to narrow the fee pool.

Unrelated terms (Section 8 exception, the damages exclusions, the reasonable-allocation-of-risk sentence) remain effective; use of "Customer" alongside "Corio" is a naming inconsistency worth conforming to the agreement's defined party name but does not defeat the mechanic.
No redline is needed on the exclusion of indirect damages; recommend deleting the surplus "all amounts due from Corio" phrase and the stranded "TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES".
